Name: Tidy Stable
Author: babynyaasu
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]A simple cosmetic mod that replaces the rusty trough in your horse stable with a clean one.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]If you haven't already done so, install [url=https://smapi.io]the latest version of SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod into your Mods folder.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
This mod is a content pack that loads an edited sprite for the horse stable. It gets rid of the gross-looking rusty spots, but keeps the shadows and highlights so it doesn't clash with other assets.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55613/55613-1794769312-1177190149.png[/img]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI (latest version)[/url] [/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod was inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7397]Clean Stable[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/98334533]Oklinq[/url]. Special thanks to the Content Patcher team for their excellent documentation. [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]The sprite in this mod was edited directly from the sprite in the base game. No generative AI was used in the creation of this mod.[/color]
